title: 24V Spring-Return Drip Irrigation Solenoid Valve, Hall Flowmeter & Red-Brass Manual Override
description: Canonical Layer 2 actuator and flow-metering register schema for closed-loop gravity cistern or mains-reduced drip irrigation manifolds.

registers.name: valve_open
registers.description: Solenoid coil actuation and reed-switch state register (0|1). Automatically resets to 0 upon reaching target_volume_ml, hitting max_moisture_cutoff_bp, or watchdog expiry.

registers.name: target_volume_ml
registers.description: Commanded batch dispense volume in milliliters. Local MCU counts Hall-effect turbine pulses and closes valve_open when dispensed volume reaches target_volume_ml.

registers.name: flow_rate_ml_s
registers.description: Real-time volumetric flow rate measured downstream of the RPZ atmospheric air-gap manifold.

registers.name: max_moisture_cutoff_bp
registers.description: Hardware moisture cutoff threshold in basis points. Forces valve_open = 0 immediately when paired soil_probe_v1.moisture_vwc_bp >= max_moisture_cutoff_bp.

safety_invariants.rationale: Synthetic simulation packets (QUALITY_SIMULATED = 0x01) must never actuate physical 24V irrigation relays.
Prevents waterlogging, nutrient leaching, and cistern depletion even if upstream L4 orchestrator disconnects.
Detects debris-fouled solenoid diaphragm or manual bypass left open unintentionally.
De-energizes coil to save 24V bus power and alert steward when cistern head drops to zero.
